about: Coralan (ivabradine), by brand name only, is supplied ten times from February to October 2026 to a 72-year-old man.
Trimetazidine, shown by ingredient name because it has no Australian brand, is supplied three times from January to March 2026 to a 69-year-old woman, in the middle of a 14-month history.

No trimetazidine or ivabradine is supplied: the angina medicine is isosorbide mononitrate (Imdur) and the one similar name is a short course of trimethoprim (Alprim), an antibiotic, so the criterion is not met.
